info.name: Clio API Documentation Activities Bank Transactions API
Return the data for all BankTransactions

params.name: bank_account_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single BankAccount. The keyword `null` is not valid for this field. The list will be filtered to include only the BankTransaction records with the matching property.

params.name: client_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Contact. The keyword `null` is not valid for this field. The list will be filtered to include only the BankTransaction records with the matching property.

params.name: created_since
params.description: Filter BankTransaction records to those having the `created_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: ids[]
params.description: Filter BankTransaction records to those having the specified unique identifiers.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of BankTransaction records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: matter_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Matter. The keyword `null` is not valid for this field. The list will be filtered to include only the BankTransaction records with the matching property.

params.name: order
params.description: Orders the BankTransaction records by the given field. Default: `id(asc)`.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter BankTransaction records to those having a specific type.

params.name: unreconciled_only
params.description: Filter BankTransaction records to only those that are unreconciled

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Filter BankTransaction records to those having the `updated_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).
